event_records.description: Rosa reflects on her application timing from last spring and wonders if submitting a week earlier would have led to an interview.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.persona_brief:
You are Rosa.
Rosa is an applicant who submitted her application a week later than she could have. She believes her qualifications are strong and wonders if timing affected the outcome.

hiring_committee.name: Hiring Committee
hiring_committee.persona_brief:
You are Hiring Committee.
The Hiring Committee reviews applications and decides whom to interview. They have a standard process: applications received by a certain date are considered in the first round; later applications may be reviewed if time permits. They do not know Rosa personally.

resolution.question: If Rosa had sent her application a week earlier last spring, would she have gotten the interview?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, during the simulation, the Hiring Committee decides to offer Rosa an interview after reviewing her application (submitted a week earlier than in reality). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
